config.name: Aircraft in the picture
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT uniqExact(hex) AS "Aircraft in the last 6 minutes"
FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       upper(toString(_json.hex)) AS hex,
       ifNull(nullIf(trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), ''), upper(toString(_json.hex))) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lat)) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lon)) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.track)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.gs)) AS speed,
       toString(_json.alt_baro) = 'ground' AS grounded,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.alt_baro)) AS altitude,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.baro_rate)) AS rate,
       toString(_json.t) AS type
FROM dfe.`adsb-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 6 MINUTE

config.name: Vessels in the picture
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT uniqExact(track) AS "Vessels in the last minute"
FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       toString(_json.mmsi) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[2])) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[1])) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.cog)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.sog)) AS speed,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.properties.navStat)) AS status
FROM dfe.`ais-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE

config.name: Reports by feed
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT feed AS "Feed",
       count() AS "Reports",
       uniqExact(track) AS "Tracks",
       formatDateTime(max(ts), '%H:%i:%S') AS "Last report (UTC)"
FROM (
  SELECT 'air' AS feed, ts, hex AS track FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       upper(toString(_json.hex)) AS hex,
       ifNull(nullIf(trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), ''), upper(toString(_json.hex))) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lat)) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lon)) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.track)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.gs)) AS speed,
       toString(_json.alt_baro) = 'ground' AS grounded,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.alt_baro)) AS altitude,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.baro_rate)) AS rate,
       toString(_json.t) AS type
FROM dfe.`adsb-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'sea' AS feed, ts, track FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       toString(_json.mmsi) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[2])) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[1])) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.cog)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.sog)) AS speed,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.properties.navStat)) AS status
FROM dfe.`ais-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
)
GROUP BY feed
ORDER BY feed

config.name: The picture now: last report per track
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT feed AS "Feed",
       track AS "Track",
       round(argMax(lat, ts), 4) AS "Lat",
       round(argMax(lon, ts), 4) AS "Lon",
       round(argMax(heading, ts)) AS "Heading",
       round(argMax(speed, ts), 1) AS "Speed (kn)",
       argMax(altitude, ts) AS "Altitude (ft)",
       dateDiff('second', max(ts), now()) AS "Last seen (s ago)"
FROM (
  SELECT 'air' AS feed, ts, track, lat, lon, heading, speed, if(grounded, 'ground', ifNull(toString(altitude), '')) AS altitude FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       upper(toString(_json.hex)) AS hex,
       ifNull(nullIf(trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), ''), upper(toString(_json.hex))) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lat)) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lon)) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.track)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.gs)) AS speed,
       toString(_json.alt_baro) = 'ground' AS grounded,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.alt_baro)) AS altitude,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.baro_rate)) AS rate,
       toString(_json.t) AS type
FROM dfe.`adsb-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'sea' AS feed, ts, track, lat, lon, heading, speed, '' AS altitude FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       toString(_json.mmsi) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[2])) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.geometry.coordinates[1])) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.cog)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.properties.sog)) AS speed,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.properties.navStat)) AS status
FROM dfe.`ais-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
)
GROUP BY feed, track
ORDER BY feed, track
LIMIT 300
